dataset_title: Vicmap Planning: Planning Scheme Zones and Overlays

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Every object ID in both Melbourne LGA planning layers is fetched and layer edit times remain unchanged during collection

invariants.planning_status_rule: Planning zones and overlays represent legal planning controls and planning status; they must NEVER be automatically marked or treated as approved development projects.
invariants.polygon_geometry_rule: Polygons and MultiPolygons are split into individual parts so each GeoRecord has a valid single Polygon geometry; coordinates are in WGS84 and never inverted.
invariants.effective_time_rule: gaz_begin_date is preserved as valid_from; time_missing_reason documents that layer has an edit timestamp rather than per-feature publication time.
invariants.status_rule: license_status stays review_required and access_status candidate until real collection and formal licensing review are completed.
